items:
Work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category

Safety rope with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area must be used.

Wear your safety 
 helmet 
 and 
 safety 
 shoes

Observe the whole state of the transformer to discover if 
 there is any up normal thing such as oil leakage, up normal sound emitting 
 from transformer or from fans, etc ...

Check that the following valves are opened:
 * Conservator 
 valves
 * Radiators 
 valves

Check that the following valves are closed:
 * Filter 
 (lower) and drain valve 
 * Filter (upper) and filling valve
 * Oil 
 sampling valve 
 * Oil drain valve for main tank
 * Oil drain 
 and filling valve for OLTC

Check the oil level in conservator and its correspondence 
 with the temperature (the part to the main tank of transformer and the part 
 related to the tap changer)
Check the earth links and earthing system.

Check the condition of silica-gel and the oil in the 
 air-dehydrator, change if necessary,
Check the condition of the cooling system and fans.

Observe readings of transformer thermometers for oil and 
 winding temperature
